claims.claim: Equipoise does not sync: no entity carries a UUID, an updatedAt stamp or a deletion tombstone.

evidence.quote: * Merge-by-id inside one transaction: rows with a known id are replaced, new ones added, nothing
@Query("DELETE FROM checkin WHERE id = :id") suspend fun delete(id: Long)

missed.fact: The map's 'does not sync' is true only for live sync. There is a file-based merge (Importer.merge), so the merge-by-id conflict rule already exists. Every row is identified by a device-local autoGenerate Long id, with no UUID or updatedAt. Two phones that each made check-in id=1 will silently overwrite each other on import.

The merge conflict rule is OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE on the primary key: the imported row always wins, with no timestamp comparison. The same rule applies to checkin, sensory_log, masking_entry, regulation_event, task and daily_index.
Deletes are hard deletes with no tombstone. The merge comment says 'nothing else is deleted', so a row deleted on one device comes back from any export that still holds it.

masking_entry has a unique index on date as well as an autoGenerate id. REPLACE can therefore delete a different local row that has the same date but another id, and an imported id can overwrite an unrelated local row. The natural key is date, and the merge keys on id.
daily_index is keyed by the date string, so it has a natural key. It is also derived data that is exported and replaced, not recomputed.

regulation_event.checkinId is a foreign key to checkin.id with onDelete = CASCADE. REPLACE on checkin is a delete plus an insert, so it can cascade-delete local regulation events that reference the replaced id.
task.parentId is an unenforced self-reference by local id (no ForeignKey), so ids that collide on import can re-parent subtasks.
Timestamps exist but are event times, not modification stamps: 'at', 'doneAt' and 'chosenAt' (epoch ms). Snapshot carries only a single exportedAt and no per-row updatedAt.
Settings is a single row with id=1 and is upserted wholesale on import (last import wins). pending_outcome and llm_settings are not exported.

absence_probes.pattern: sync|Sync|merge|conflict in app/src/main (excluding kotlinx Mutex imports)
